description:
Sales Support Administrator

Hours: 9am - 3pm 3 days per week

Location: Horsham

Salary: 14 - 15 p/h Permanent Equivalent

We are looking for a highly organised and proactive Sales Support Administrator to join our clients growing team. This varied role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service while ensuring administrative processes run smoothly.

You will play a key role in supporting order fulfilment, stock management, invoicing, logistics coordination, and general business administration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage customer orders from receipt through to dispatch, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.

  • Generate and issue sales invoices accurately and within agreed timescales.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within the company CRM system.

  • Handle business correspondence, filing systems, and document control procedures.
  • Provide general administrative support across the business and contribute to new initiatives as the company continues to grow.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Previous experience in an administrative, operations, customer service, or sales support role.
  • Good communication skills with the confidence to liaise with customers, suppliers, warehouse teams, and carriers.
  • Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure.
  • A proactive, flexible approach and willingness to support the wider team when required.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities.
  • A supportive and collaborative working environment.
  • An extra discretionary paid day off when your birthday falls on a normal working day.
  • The opportunity to grow with an expanding business.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
• Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent
  • Location: Redditch
  • Salary: £26-28,000
  • Hours: Flexible between 08 00 / early finish at 1 pm on a Friday (37.5 hours in total)
Sales Administrator Summary

We're looking for a highly organised and customer-focused Sales Administration & Customer Service Executive to join our clients team. This is a key role acting as the vital link between sales, manufacturing, and logistics, ensuring every customer order is processed accurately, delivered on time, and handled with a first-class level of service. You'll take ownership of the end-to-end order process, keep our SAP system running like clockwork, and be the go-to person when customers need clear answers, fast.

Sales Administrator Role

In this role, you'll sit at the centre of the order-to-delivery process supporting the sales administration team and gaining first-hand exposure to how data accuracy, system discipline, and cross-department coordination drive customer service performance.

Sales Administrator Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the end-to-end sales order process from enquiry through to delivery, ensuring accuracy and adherence to customer requirements.
  • Maintain and oversee all sales data within the SAP system, ensuring records are kept up to date and correctly reflect order status and delivery schedules.
  • Coordinate closely with manufacturing and logistics teams to ensure customer expectations for delivery are met or exceeded.
  • Act as the first point of contact for customer queries, ensuring professional, accurate, and timely resolution.
  • Support the monitoring and reporting of order processing performance, customer satisfaction, and delivery KPIs.
  • Identify and suggest improvements to processes and systems to drive efficiency and enhance service levels.
  • Work closely with colleagues across sales admin, manufacturing, and logistics to manage multiple priorities and keep orders moving smoothly.
About You
  • Strong attention to detail and process discipline.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, ideally SAP.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A proactive problem solver with a genuine customer-first mindset.
  • Comfortable coordinating across departments and managing competing priorities.
  • Previous experience in a sales administration, order processing, or customer service role is desirable.
Why This Role?
  • Career pathway into sales and account management.
  • Direct exposure to SAP/ERP systems, KPI reporting, and supply chain coordination
  • Work across the hospitality and retail sectors with strong long-term demand
  • Structured support from an experienced sales administration team

description:
Sales Administrator

Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire

£30,000 Per Annum + Excellent Benefits! (See Below)

We at JKR are recruiting an enthusiastic individual, for one of our key clients, a growing manufacturing company in Tewkesbury!

Sales Administrator Main Purpose and Scope of Role:

The Sales Administrator is a newly created role at the heart of our client's order-to-delivery process, providing the administrative backbone that allows the Account Management team to focus on customer relationships and account growth.

Working within the Commercial team, the Sales Administrator is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of all customer orders, the maintenance of order data across internal systems (including the company's order-loading system and Salesforce CRM), and the coordination of information between Sales, Supply Chain, and Production to ensure commitments are consistently met.

This is a high-volume, fast-paced role that demands exceptional accuracy, strong organisational skills, and a proactive approach to communication. It also offers a genuine, structured development pathway into Account Management for the right individual who demonstrates the commercial and relationship skills required to progress.

Sales Administrator Main Duties:

  • Process incoming customer orders accurately and promptly onto internal systems, ensuring all order details, quantities, pricing, and commercial terms are correctly captured and verified before confirmation

  • Enter and maintain sales order information across the company's order-loading system and Salesforce CRM, maintaining data integrity and audit trails for all orders, amendments, and cancellations

  • Ensure Supply Chain and Production always have clear, accurate, and timely visibility of material requirements arising from confirmed customer orders, communicating any changes or priority shifts promptly

  • Support Account Managers with internal order status queries and coordination activity, ensuring a smooth and well-documented handover of orders from quotation through to fulfilment

  • Identify and flag discrepancies, including pricing errors, stock shortfalls, lead time risks, and delivery threats, escalating promptly to the relevant Account Manager or Supply Chain contact with sufficient detail for a timely resolution

  • Maintain accurate, auditable records of all order activity, including amendments, cancellations, delivery confirmations, and customer correspondence related to order administration

  • Produce regular order status and administrative reports for the Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain teams, highlighting any open issues, overdue actions, or at-risk orders

  • Liaise proactively with internal departments including Production, Planning, Quality, and Supply Chain to chase order updates, resolve administrative queries, and ensure customers receive accurate delivery information

  • Support the Account Management team during peak periods with quotation administration, customer communications, and general commercial support tasks as directed

  • Comply with all Company Health and Safety procedures and contribute to maintaining a safe, organised, and compliant working environment

Sales Administrator Person Specification:

  • Sales order processing and administration within a manufacturing, engineering, or technical environment
  • Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel at intermediate level or above (data entry, order tracking, reporting)
  • Supply chain and production coordination: understanding of how orders translate into material and capacity requirements
  • Commercial awareness: pricing structures, order terms, and the importance of accuracy in high-value, technically complex orders
  • Proven ability to handle high-volume, fast-paced data entry and order management with a very high level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Experience using a CRM, ERP, or MRP system
  • GCSE Maths and English (Grade C / 4 or above) or equivalent - essential for order accuracy and reporting

description:
Start your career somewhere you'll make a difference from day one.

Looking for a role where you'll gain real responsibility, work with customers, solve problems and develop skills that will set you up for your future career?

At Driver Hire, you'll be trusted from day one.

You'll join our National Accounts team, supporting some of the UK's largest organisations while working alongside experienced colleagues who will help you learn, develop and grow. You'll get involved in customer projects, business technology, account support and continuous improvement, helping us deliver an outstanding service to customers across the UK.

No experience in logistics? No problem. We're looking for potential, curiosity and attitude, not industry knowledge.

If you're organised, naturally curious and enjoy solving problems, we'd love to hear from you.

About Driver Hire

Driver Hire is a national business with more than 40 years of success, helping organisations across the UK solve workforce and operational challenges through a combination of people, technology and customer-focused solutions.

Our National Accounts team works with some of the country's best-known businesses, supporting their temporary workforce requirements while continually improving the systems, processes and technology that underpin our service.

The Role

This is a fantastic opportunity to build broad commercial experience early in your career.

You'll work closely with National Account Managers, customers and colleagues across the business, supporting customer accounts, helping solve operational challenges and getting involved in projects that make a real difference.

No two days are the same. One day you could be preparing for a customer review meeting, analysing data, investigating a system issue or helping deliver a technology project. Another might involve working with colleagues across our nationwide network to resolve a customer query or improve a business process.

As your confidence grows, you'll begin supporting your own portfolio of customer accounts, building relationships, understanding how customers operate and identifying opportunities to improve the service we provide.

You'll also become one of the people supporting ClearCite, our customer technology platform, helping customers get the most from the system while working with colleagues across the business to investigate issues and drive continuous improvement.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be involved in a wide range of activities, including:

Supporting National Account Managers with customer accounts and commercial activity

Building relationships with customers and our nationwide office network

Helping customers use our technology platform and resolving queries

Investigating problems and working with colleagues to find solutions

Preparing reports, analysing data and identifying trends

Supporting customer meetings, presentations and account reviews

Getting involved in projects that improve processes, customer experience and the way we work

Over time, you'll develop experience in customer relationship management, commercial account support, business technology, data analysis and project work, providing an excellent foundation for a future career in account management, customer success, commercial operations or business technology.

About You

We're much more interested in your potential than your experience.

You might be a recent graduate, have completed an apprenticeship, or already have some experience in customer service, administration or another fast-paced environment.

We're looking for someone who enjoys learning and wants to build a career.

You'll probably enjoy this role if you:

Enjoy solving problems and finding practical solutions

Take pride in getting the details right

Like working with people and building relationships

Are naturally curious and enjoy learning new things

Can organise your workload and manage competing priorities

Communicate confidently and professionally

Enjoy working as part of a supportive team

Like identifying opportunities to improve the way things are done

You don't need to know anything about logistics recruitment before joining us. We'll teach you that.

What matters most is your attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn.

Why Join Driver Hire?

This isn't a graduate scheme where you'll spend your first year watching from the sidelines.

You'll have meaningful responsibility, work directly with customers, learn from experienced colleagues and see the impact of your work from the very beginning.

You'll join a friendly, supportive team that shares knowledge, helps each other and genuinely wants everyone to succeed. As your confidence grows, so will your responsibilities, allowing you to build a career around your strengths and interests.

In return, we offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, pension, healthcare, holiday allowance and hybrid working from our Bradford Head Office.

title: Apprentice Sales Advisor - Uncapped Commission
description:
Full time: Sales Apprenticeship

Hourly rate: £11.55

Address: EE Contact Centre, Senhouse Road, Industrial Estate, Yarm Rd, Darlington DL1 4XW

Start your future with EE - Where your voice could be the start of something big - What's in it for you

  • A great starting salary of £22,527 rising to £26,116 after completion of the apprenticeship. Plus, an uncapped commission scheme.
  • An NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service following the completion of the apprenticeship (15 months).
  • Huge discounts off your Mobile and Broadband packages, starting at £10 a month.
  • Huge discounts off other tech such as Smart watches, speakers, tv's, gaming consoles and subscriptions.
  • Discount codes to give out to friends and family
  • Support to carve your own career path. We're passionate about helping our people grow the career they want.
  • Online GP: Access to a private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family

What you'll be doing

At EE, we believe every customer interaction should be a positive experience. You'll speak with customers over the phone, getting to know what matters most to them, building strong relationships, and recommending the right EE products and services to suit their needs. You'll use your energy and ambition to thrive and meet goals, and grow your skills along the way. From the latest mobile tech and broadband, and smart home solutions, every conversation is a chance to make a real impact and grow your confidence.

As part of your apprenticeship, you'll complete a 15-month NVQ Level 2 in Customer Service. We'll support you every step of the way - including one dedicated study day a week, guidance from a college tutor, and extra coaching to help you feel confident in your role.

Why choose EE


You don't need experience, all you need is a great attitude, a friendly voice, and the willingness to learn. We'll give you all the training you need and we're passionate about helping you kick start your career. At EE, you're part of something bigger. You'll make friends, learn new skills, and build confidence every day. We're proud to be inclusive and welcome people from all backgrounds - because everyone belongs here.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and let's start building your future.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
About the role

In this role, you'll be the voice of BT for our small and medium business customers - building genuine connections and providing solutions that make a real difference to their success. Every conversation matters; whether you're responding to an inbound enquiry or reaching out as part of an outbound campaign, you'll take the time to understand each customer's needs and challenges before recommending the right BT or EE Business products for them.

You'll combine your natural communication skills with your existing sales experience to spot opportunities, tailor solutions, and deliver results that meet - and often exceed - your targets. Above all, you'll ensure every interaction is a positive one, creating a customer experience that reflects BT's reputation for trust, expertise and innovation.

You'll deliver defined revenue, product volume and quality targets through the acquisition, up-sell and retention of UK SME customers. Sales opportunities are initiated by either an inbound blend or outbound call as part of a specific campaign and in accordance with business requirements. You will answer and respond to customer enquiries efficiently, effectively and appropriately in accordance with defined processes and procedures.

The Customer Growth Advisor plays a key role in retaining and growing our small and medium business customers.

The role is a blend of inbound calls and/or outbound focused, engaging existing customers to protect contracts, reduce churn, and identify growth opportunities. The outbound team may also provide inbound support during peak demand, ensuring customers receive timely, high quality service.

This role requires strong customer conversations, commercial judgement, and flexibility to support business needs.

By delivering compliant, value led conversations and supporting key customer programmes, the role plays a direct part in strengthening long term customer relationships while supporting wider transformation and efficiency goals.

What you will be doing

Inbound Customer Growth-

  • Support inbound call volumes during busy periods and make outbound dialler calls in quieter times.
  • Identify upsell and cross sell opportunities aligned to customer needs efficiently and professionally.
  • Take ownership of issues through to resolution, using correct processes.
  • Deliver a consistent customer experience across inbound and outbound activity.
  • Customer & Process Excellence
  • Maintain accurate customer records and contact details.
  • Follow all sales, compliance, and data protection requirements.
  • Use CRM and sales systems correctly at all times.
  • Escalate risks, complaints, or vulnerabilities appropriately.
  • Work closely with wider teams to resolve issues and improve outcomes.

Outbound Customer Growth-

  • Proactively contact existing SMB customers to:
    • Protect customers at risk of churn.
    • Support contract renewals and retention activity.
    • Identify upsell and cross sell opportunities aligned to customer needs.
  • Hold confident, value based conversations focused on long term customer outcomes.
  • Clearly explain products, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Ensure customers receive correct information and documentation before orders are placed.

Performance & Collaboration-

  • Deliver against agreed performance measures, including quality, retention, and growth.
  • Actively engage in coaching, feedback, and development sessions.

Support a "one team" culture by sharing best practice and helping colleagues.

What you'll need to succeed

Essential

  • Strong communication and listening skills.
  • Confidence handling objections and challenging conversations.
  • Ability to balance customer needs with commercial outcomes.
  • High attention to detail and strong compliance mindset.
  • Comfortable working across inbound and outbound activity.

Desirable

  • Experience in outbound or inbound sales and retention
  • Experience working with SMB or business customers.
  • Knowledge of telecoms or B2B services.
  • Experience using CRM and sales
Benefits

Tailored benefits make a real difference. That's why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:

  • Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
  • Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
  • Equalized maternity, paternity, and adoption leave - 18 weeks' full pay and 8 weeks' half pay
  • Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
  • Market leading Pension scheme - 5% from you and 10% from us
  • Holiday purchase scheme

You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you're ready.

You don't need experience, all you need is a great attitude, a friendly voice, and the willingness to learn. Role Description

The Account Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Cardiff. In this role, the Account Manager will manage day-to-day relationships with key clients, acting as the primary point of contact for service delivery and performance queries. Responsibilities include overseeing contract execution, coordinating with operational teams, monitoring service quality against agreed KPIs, and preparing regular reports on performance and customer satisfaction. This position also involves collaborating with internal stakeholders, participating in client meetings, and ensuring that all activities align with company standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships and manage expectations with multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in organizing workloads, prioritizing tasks, and managing time effectively in a fast-paced, service-led environment.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, including experience with reporting, KPI tracking, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Comfort with using standard business software (e.g., MS Office, CRM tools) and producing clear written documentation and presentations.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with operations teams on-site, demonstrating leadership, accountability, and a focus on service quality.
  • Previous experience in the UK or Irish service sectors and knowledge of relevant compliance or health and safety standards is beneficial.
  • Relevant professional qualification or equivalent practical experience in business, management, or a related field is desirable.

Services Sales Coordinator

Location: London (1/2 days a week)

Contract: 6 Months

Rate: £300-£350 per day (Outside IR35)

We're partnering with a leading global technology organisation to recruit an experienced Services Sales Coordinator to join their Professional Services team on an initial 6-month contract.

This role sits at the heart of the Professional Services Sales function, supporting the sales process from initial customer engagement through to project handover. Working closely with Account Managers, Professional Services Consultants and Project Managers, you'll coordinate services opportunities, prepare customer proposals and ensure everything is in place before work moves into delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the Professional Services Sales team throughout the sales lifecycle.
  • Coordinate Professional Services opportunities from initial enquiry through to project handover.
  • Work with Account Managers to understand customer requirements and define the appropriate services offering.
  • Schedule discovery calls and planning meetings with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate the preparation of Statements of Work (SOWs), proposals, quotations and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with pricing requests, approvals and general commercial administration.
  • Track opportunities through Salesforce (or a similar CRM), ensuring records remain accurate and up to date.
  • Liaise with Professional Services teams to confirm resource availability, timelines and project readiness.
  • Act as the central point of coordination between Sales, Professional Services and customers throughout the pre-sales process.
  • Support forecasting, reporting and general administrative activities for the Services Sales team.
  • Ensure a smooth handover of signed opportunities into the delivery team.

About You

  • Previous experience in a Services Sales Coordinator, Sales Coordinator, Sales Support, Professional Services Coordinator or similar role.
  • Experience supporting sales activities within a technology, cloud, networking or IT services environment.
  • Comfortable coordinating proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), quotations and customer-facing documentation.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Commercially minded with a good understanding of the sales lifecycle.
  • Experience using Salesforce or another CRM platform is highly desirable.
  • Previous exposure to Professional Services or technology consulting would be advantageous.
  • Fluent English is essential.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager

An excellent opportunity for a proactive, confident and commercially minded sales professional to join a hospitality consultancy, supporting a varied portfolio of hospitality clients with prebooked sales growth, corporate bookings, agency relationships and new business opportunities.

If you've also worked in the following roles, we'd also like to hear from you: Sales Manager, Business Development Executive, Account Manager, Corporate Sales Manager, Sales Executive, New Business Manager, Client Relationship Manager, Partnerships Manager, Sales Consultant, Sales Representative

SALARY: £40,000 - £45,000 per annum plus quarterly bonus + Benefits

LOCATION: Central London

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent

WORKING HOURS: 5 days per week - 42.5 hours

JOB OVERVIEW

This is an exciting opportunity for a Business Development Manager who enjoys proactive sales, relationship building and working with hospitality clients to generate enquiries, bookings and revenue growth.

As the Business Development Manager, you will be deployed to hospitality clients to identify new streams of business, grow corporate and consumer sales, and develop opportunities through direct, agency, third-party and booking platform channels.

The Business Development Manager will work closely with venue operations and marketing teams, ensuring sales activity is aligned with logistical capability, brand positioning, client needs and agreed KPIs.

APPLY TODAY

Ready to make your next career move? Apply Now for our Recruitment Team to review.

DUTIES

Your duties as the Business Development Manager include:

  • Generate New Business: Identify, approach and develop new corporate, consumer and agency sales opportunities for hospitality clients
  • Build Local Sales Plans: Research the local area, identify key businesses, event bookers, social committees, personal assistants and office managers, and create targeted sales activity
  • Develop Client Relationships: Contact prospective clients, nurture relationships and generate first enquiries for events, functions and venue bookings
  • Use Sales Data: Engage suitable target clients using existing data sources, previous bookers and sourced prospect lists
  • Drive Channel Sales: Promote venues through agency, third-party, listing sites and booking platforms
  • Manage Booking Platforms: Set up and engage relevant booking platforms such as Tag, Venuescanner, Hirespace and Togather
  • Use LinkedIn Proactively: Promote client venues, network, research prospects and reach out to local businesses
  • Convert Enquiries: Respond quickly to incoming enquiries by phone, email and website, converting opportunities efficiently
  • Attend Showrounds: Meet customers face to face, present venues professionally and support the sales process through to booking
  • Prepare Sales Administration: Complete invoicing, contracts, function sheets, reporting, pre-orders and CRM updates accurately
  • Report on Activity: Provide weekly updates on sales activity, enquiries, bookings and opportunities against agreed targets
  • Communicate Effectively: Work closely with line management, client teams, venue operations and marketing colleagues

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Enthusiastic, positive, energetic and self-motivated approach
  • Passion for selling, achieving targets and maximising bonus opportunities
  • Good understanding of the hospitality industry, including bars, restaurants, pubs and newer hospitality sectors
  • Strong interpersonal, written, verbal and presentation skills
  • Confident building, nurturing and managing external relationships
  • Able to work independently, take ownership and manage proactive sales activity
  • Excellent planning, organisation and time management skills
  • Adaptable, commercially aware and comfortable managing change
  • Confident using the phone, closing deals and communicating with clients
  • Familiarity using booking and CRM systems such as Collins, Tripleseat or HubSpot
  • Organised and efficient when using calendars, emails and CRM systems
  • Presentable, creative and resourceful when working virtually and in person

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details. CV's of Job Applicants meeting this requirement will be submitted to our Client for consideration. By submitting your job application to us you are hereby giving us your express consent to submit your details to our Client for this purpose.

This is not a desk job and it's not a call centre role. You'll be out on the road every day, visiting customers in their homes, understanding their needs, and providing expert guidance and quotations for their move. title: Trainee Business Development Manager
description:
Roles like this really are few and far between. And what makes this one particularly special, is the fact that it sits within what is arguably the most exciting commercial insurer in the UK market right now.

As a result of an internal promotion, this Trainee Business Development Manager opportunity has arisen within the Sales & Distribution team of this highly prestigious insurer.

Our client operates in over 20 countries, and is very much renowned as a world-leader within its chosen markets. The company arranges insurance for some of the most fascinating risks on the planet, and has a reputation for excellence, innovation and formidable customer service.

This Trainee BDM opportunity is extremely refreshing because our client is seeking someone who they can mould and nurture, and as such, it is not essential that you have previous experience within an official business development role. In fact, the person who did this role very successfully (before being promoted into a more senior BDM role), came from an underwriting background.

You will be responsible for promoting the company's suite of commercial insurance products to a panel of brokers all over the UK. Your duties will include, but certainly not be limited to, making Discovery telephone calls to brokers in order to find out what kind of business they are writing, and which of this insurer's products will be relevant to them. In addition, you'll identify specific risks for which the underwriting team can quote, and then follow the sales process through to the inception of cover. You'll build strong relationships with your broker panel, ensuring that you are at the forefront of their mind when they are looking for quotes, and you will work closely with the regional business development team to ensure that sales objectives are met. Much of your work will be conducted over the telephone, but you will be encouraged to attend some face-to-face broker visits.

When it comes to career development opportunities, this opportunity has them in abundance. The previous incumbent was promoted into a more senior BDM role within 12 months and there are many different areas of the business that you could move into down the line.

It is absolutely essential that you have previous general insurance experience, either from an insurer or broker background. Ideally, this experience will have included commercial insurance products, although we will consider exceptional candidates from a personal lines / high net worth background. Just as importantly, you will be engaging, inquisitive, and good at spotting opportunities. You'll have superb communication skills, as well as the ability to build strong rapport with brokers. Given the nature of the role, you will enjoy working to targets.

Many people who join this company cite, "this is the best place I have ever worked at". It is genuinely difficult to find a company that invests so heavily in its staff because they want them to benefit from "proper careers, where every member of staff has a mentor."

Our client operates a hybrid-working arrangement, allowing you to work 2 days from home. The team are well-renowned in the industry for their friendly, supportive and collaborative environment, and there are lots of sports and social events available, including an incredible annual summer ball!

You'll be rewarded with a generous basic salary (Negotiable depending on experience), plus a highly lucrative bonus scheme and impressive corporate benefits, which include substantial pension contributions and financial bonuses for passing CII qualifications.

Role Overview:
The Talent Set are delighted to partner with the client on a fantastic Sales Executive role. This position involves driving membership growth for a prominent industry organisation through proactive outreach, relationship building, and sales activity, all supported by comprehensive training within a collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify potential membership prospects through inbound and outbound communication.
  • Manage sales enquiries, nurture leads, and guide applicants through the membership application process.
  • Develop and deliver tailored proposals to meet individual customer needs.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, tracking all sales activities and customer interactions.
  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets by converting interest into memberships.
  • Represent the organisation at industry events, exhibitions, and networking opportunities.
  • Keep informed about the full range of membership products and industry competitors.
  • Provide exceptional customer experience throughout the sales journey.
  • Prepare regular sales reports and updates in accordance with organizational procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with data protection policies and relevant legislation.
  • Collaborate with colleagues and participate in ongoing training to enhance sales skills and product knowledge.

Person Specification:

  • Proven experience in sales, particularly with membership or service subscriptions, ideally with CRM systems such as Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Skilled in initiating cold calls and following up on warm leads with a customer-focused approach.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a friendly and professional telephone manner.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and demonstrate good questioning and listening skills.
  • Organised, with effective time management and prioritisation capabilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable working both independently and within a team.
  • A keen willingness to learn about industry products, market trends, and the organisation's services.

What's on Offer:

  • Salary: £35,000 pro-rata
  • Location: London - Hybrid
  • Contract: 6 months

How to Apply:
To apply, please submit your CV demonstrating your suitability for this role by clicking the 'apply now' button (please do not apply via email). We aim to get back to all successful candidates within 48 working hours.

Commitment to Diversity:
The Talent Set are committed to diverse and inclusive recruitment practices, ensuring equal opportunities for all applicants regardless of race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, disability, or age. We actively encourage applications from a wide range of backgrounds and are always happy to make reasonable adjustments to ensure a fair recruitment process.

title: Wholesale Sales Executive for Luxurious Fashion Apparel
description:
Wholesale Sales Executive (Fashion Brand)

Position Overview

A global fashion brand is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales professional to manage and grow its wholesale business. This role focuses on order-taking during showrooms and trade shows, building long-term client relationships, and driving sustainable sales growth within the mid- to high-end fashion segment.

Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Operations & Order Management
• Manage the end-to-end wholesale order process, from order entry and
confirmations through to delivery and invoicing for Women s business, with
support across Men s orders when required
• Coordinate closely with production, logistics, merchandising, and finance to
ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment
• Monitor stock availability and support reorders, amendments, and allocation
updates
• Handle order discrepancies, delivery queries, and customer requests with
professionalism and efficiency
Reporting & Commercial Support
• Maintain accurate wholesale systems, customer records, and order data
• Track sales performance, deliveries, and seasonal progress against targets
• Support sell-through analysis, forecasting, and end-of-season reporting
• Ensure adherence to wholesale pricing policies, margins, and commercial terms
Showroom & Market Support
• Assist in the preparation and organisation of the showroom for market weeks
and buyer appointments
• Coordinate samples, merchandising, and seasonal materials during selling
periods
• Provide on-site or remote support during trade shows and market appointments
as required

Skills & Experience
• 1 3+ years experience in wholesale sales, operations, or client support (luxury
or premium womenswear preferred, menswear exposure a plus)
• Strong understanding of wholesale processes, timelines, and commercial
structures
• Highly detail-oriented with excellent organisational and communication skills
• Confident working across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
• Proficient in Excel and comfortable using ERP / wholesale management systems
• Professional, service-driven approach aligned with a luxury brand ethos

Confidentiality Notice
This position is strictly confidential. As the search is being conducted discreetly, all information related to this role must not be shared with any third party.

We regret to inform applicants that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Thank you for your understanding

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience handling Women s collections

  • Experience with international or imported fashion brands

  • Strong negotiation, relationship-building, and communication skills

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Commercially driven with a strong client-focused mindset

  • Able to proactively build connections and drive sales opportunities

  • Capable of representing the brand with professionalism and confidence

  • Flexible and adaptable to fast-paced, seasonal showroom environments

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
decision_reason: broad sales/business-development title outside Customer Sales seam
description:
Join the UK's No1 Trade Kitchen Supplier

Howdens are recruiting Kitchen Sales Designers who thrive in a fast-paced, sales environment. We're looking for commercially minded individuals who can build strong relationships, influence buying decisions and exceed sales targets.

We can offer you a successful career as a Kitchen Sales Designer, and you don't need previous design experience. We'll provide you with comprehensive design and sales training to create exceptional kitchens for our trade customers and their clients.

What we can offer you:
  • Competitive salary, brilliant bonuses and outstanding depot incentives
  • Kitchen Sales Designer training programme
  • Excellent pension plan with up to 12% company contribution
  • Up to 32 days annual leave, including bank holidays.
  • Holiday entitlement rises with service
  • Generous staff discount on Howdens products
  • Buy-as-you-earn share scheme
  • 40 hour working week
  • No evening, Sunday or Bank Holiday working
  • Virtual GP access and wellbeing support for you and your family
  • A strong team culture that genuinely sets us apart


What we are looking for:
  • Results driven with experience of reaching sales targets and KPI
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with our trade customers and their client
  • Excellent communication skills, able to convey your ideas clearly and effectively
  • Full UK Driving license with access to your own vehicle for home visits
  • Strong attention to detail and an eye for design
  • CAD skills are preferred, but not essential as you will receive training


What you will be doing:
  • Driving sales performance and profit by achieving your depot targets
  • Building strong customer relationships through professional design support
  • Delivering exceptional customer service throughout the project
  • Conducting home visits to measure, assess and understand your client's needs
  • Negotiating prices confidently while protecting margin and design integrity
  • Planning and creating inspirational and practical designs utilising your strong product knowledge to advise customers and resolve queries throughout the process


What it's like to work here:
  • We take pride in getting things right first time for our customers
  • Everyone pulls their weight and supports each other as one team
  • It's a busy depot, so we keep things simple, work fast and get the job done
  • We all play a part in the depot's success and share in the team bonus
  • We build trust by doing what we say we will, every day


How to apply:
If Howdens sounds like the kind of place where you can build and develop your career as a Kitchen Sales Designer, then we are keen to hear from you.

About Howdens:
Howdens Joinery is a highly successful FTSE 100 business, with more than 900 depots nationwide and more than 11,000 staff. Last year our sales reached circa 2.3bn, and we continue to experience significant growth and success. Despite our scale, Howdens remains a local business with traditional values.
There is a strong entrepreneurial ethos and the opportunity to develop within a fast-paced and commercial environment. That, along with a competitive salary, development opportunities, and exciting rewards, are among the reasons why our people enjoy working for Howdens - and why we have been named one of the 10 Best Big Companies to Work For.
Howdens is founded on the principle of being Worthwhile for ALL concerned. We're working hard to ensure we provide an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome. We will do everything we can to support you during your application. If you need us to make any adjustments to our recruitment process, please email (url removed) with the job title and location, and we will be happy to help you.
Please note that candidates applying for this role must have a valid right to work in the UK, we do not offer sponsorship of employment for any depot positions at this time. We appreciate your understanding.

description:
Sales Executive - Growth Team

£28k-£30k + comm - 25 days holidays

Looking to kick-start a serious career in sales? This is a hands-on, high-impact role working alongside a Senior Account Manager to grow and develop major strategic accounts.

As a Sales Executive, you'll get deep exposure to how large accounts operate - learning who the decision-makers are, where the opportunities sit, and how to turn insight into revenue. You'll play a key role in identifying new opportunities, booking high-quality meetings, and helping unlock growth across existing customers.

Our client is looking for someone curious, driven, and proactive - someone who doesn't wait to be told, but enjoys digging into accounts, spotting potential, and building relationships. If you're ambitious and want a clear pathway into roles like Junior Account Manager or Business Development Manager, this is the perfect foundation.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analyse and map major accounts to understand structures, stakeholders, and growth opportunities
  • Book high-quality meetings with new contacts, departments, and decision-makers
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities across services and solutions
  • Engage customers confidently over the phone and via professional email communication
  • Support the Senior Account Manager with account insights, meeting prep, follow-ups, and opportunity development
  • Consistently hit sales activity KPIs
  • Deliver excellent customer service at every touchpoint
  • Produce accurate quotes using approved pricing and discount models
  • Keep CRM data, reports, and documentation accurate and up to date
  • Manage your workload effectively to maximise impact across key accounts
  • Actively engage in training and development to accelerate your progression

What We're Looking For

  • A proactive, self-motivated mindset with strong attention to detail
  • Confidence communicating with stakeholders at all levels
  • Curiosity and commercial awareness - you enjoy understanding how businesses work
  • Strong organisation and time management skills
  • A genuine desire to build a long-term career in sales

title: Sales Advisor - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 05/10/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths

  • Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.

  • It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.

  • People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

  • GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

  • UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

  • BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

  • GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

  • FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

  • GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established organisation within the residential property sector, where you will have the opportunity to build strong professional relationships, manage your own portfolio of properties and play a key role in delivering a high-quality service to homeowners.

title: Retail Sales Assistant
description:
The Role

In your dream role, you ll receive:

  • Competitive salary: £13,000 achievable on target earnings
  • Commission: Our uncapped commission scheme recognises the hard work and dedication of our superstar dreamers, with extra special peak incentives.
  • Discounts: Amazing colleague discount on Dreams products, plus hundreds of brands including restaurants, holidays, and shopping.
  • Buy-in schemes: You ll have the opportunity to buy extra holiday, private healthcare, or savings and loans.
  • Learning and development: Our comprehensive induction gives you the best possible start to your career with us, Whether it s a bitesize course on our Beducation learning platform or face-to-face training from our L&D team, there are heaps of ways to keep your skills sharp at Dreams, with progression opportunities as your experience grows.
  • Wellbeing: We partner with the Retail Trust to offer a full wellness hub, including a 24-hour helpline, out of hours GP services and access to counselling.
  • New in 2024 - enhanced maternity & paternity pay
The job:Working as part of our Retail team in Edinburgh Straiton for 16 hours a week, you will be a vital part of the store s success.We want every store visit to be exceptional for our customers, so you ll work closely with members of the public to understand their needs and advise them on high-value purchases.Ready to skip the snooze button and get stuck in? Here s a taste of what you ll be doing day-to-day
  • Making our customers feel at home through exceptional service. At Dreams, this means listening to customer s needs and guiding them, asking the right questions at the right time to find the perfect fit.
  • Being on hand every step of the way whilst customers browse in store, from greeting at the door to getting to know them and their sleep preferences.
  • Becoming a Sleepmatch Master, using our market-leading sleep technology to help customers choose the right mattress just for them. Sleepmatch is our bit of wizardry that makes the bed buying process simple and you ll love it!
  • Helping to make the store look its absolute best, from general housekeeping and cleaning to updating displays.

The Person

This is the type of person we re dreaming of:

  • People-first: You will have an engaging and positive personality, plus a natural ability to bond with customers.
  • Communicator: Using your excellent communications skills, you ll be able to build rapport and establish great relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Motivated: Whilst no previous sales experience is necessary, you will need to have the determination and motivation to work towards KPIs and sales targets.
  • Team player: Every dreamer plays a role in making our stores an enjoyable place to work, where each member of the team feels included and respected.
  • Willing to learn: A great night s sleep is personal, so natural curiosity and willingness to learn will make you an excellent Bed Expert.
  • Flexible: You ll need to be able to commit to working 16 hours per week. Our stores are awake 7 days a week, so this role will involve working weekends, along with shifts during the week days, and bank holidays. On these busy days, you ll have the opportunity earn even more commission!

About Dreams

About us:At Dreams, we know your bed is the best place in the whole world. But for the hours between precious sleep, we d like to make work a special place to be too. We re the UK s most loved bed retailer, so it s important our people feel the love as well.Together we ve been making bedtimes better since 1985, with no signs of hitting the snooze button. We re owned by the world s largest bedding provider, Tempur Sealy, and sell 14,000 mattresses, bases and headboards every single week. Now that s a lot of Zzzs.With over 200 stores nationwide, you ll join our team of sleep-savvy Bed Experts in a fun and friendly environment where every dreamer makes a difference. So if you re bonkers about bed, silly for siestas and keen on your kip, Dreams could be the perfect place for you.Dreams. Love your job.

description:
EE Merthyr Tydfil Contact Centre - Part-time role - 20.0 Hours per week

Part-time shift pattern:

Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday

4:45PM - 9PM 4:45PM - 9PM 4:45PM - 9PM 4:45PM - 9PM 4:45PM - 9PM OFF OFF

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Merthyr is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Merthyr contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths

  • Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.

  • It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.

  • People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 pro-rata which goes up to £26,738 pro-rata after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

The Role

As our client continues to grow, we're looking to bring a hungry, commercially minded Business Development Executive into the team.

• Speaking with UK SMEs about funding requirements, specifically focussing on invoice finance and cashflow lending.

• Confident communicator (phone-first mindset).

You really need to have worked in a more software/electronics/tech/IP licensing type of environment.

Ideally be degree level, and ideally in something closely related to software.

The Company

As more and more advanced technology is used in the Automotive/Transportation sector, we present exciting opportunities to join a growing company at a pivotal time in our industry. We are a successful Cambridge (UK) based technology spin-out, leading the way in finding creative, innovative, and above all effective ways to make time spent in-vehicle more entertaining and productive. Our connectivity and telematics software and hardware products are deployed in over 35 million vehicles and counting, across 15 of the world's largest automotive OEMs, including VW Group, Toyota, Honda, Stellantis and many more.

We supply our software across the automotive ecosystem to equipment suppliers such as Bosch, Panasonic, Clarion, Pioneer, and device vendors such as Sony and HTC. We also use our software in our Cobalt Cube hardware product, which enables devices such as PCs, tablets and specialist equipment to be displayed and controlled from the vehicle dashboard screen. It is transforming the way emergency services and fleets now interact with peripheral devices, improving efficiency and safety for their drivers.

We operate across two product streams. Our software development kits are licensed to automotive OEMs and equipment suppliers such as Bosch, with a licence fee of around €250 per unit plus ongoing shipping royalties this has historically been our core business. Over the last couple of years we've also introduced a hardware product, Cobalt Cube, built on our own software for emergency services use, and now deployed with organisations including the AA and UK police forces. These plug-and-play units sell for £800 £1,000 each and are currently moving through new customer trials.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced, committed and talented Business Development Executive with direct experience of business development within the automotive industry. This role is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced executive to join our highly successful team and take an active role in growing our global brand.

This role covers a wide range of vertical markets including mobile operators, handset vendors, Automotive OEMs and equipment suppliers. You'll be working closely with the management team, shaping business strategy, establishing strong and trusting relationships with key partners, preparing compelling value propositions and customer proposals, developing business models, negotiating commercial terms and closing deals. There is considerable scope for innovation and introducing new product ideas.

You won't be doing this alone. You'll have the backing of a dedicated pre-sales team, as well as a network of established partners you'll need to be comfortable working with and through partners, as well as selling direct. We sell through a mix of direct sales and trade shows, attending around 50 shows a year across Europe, Asia and the USA. In Europe we typically partner with Panasonic on a stand rather than running our own, so despite the number of shows, it isn't a heavy travel commitment.

When you join, you'll shadow the team on existing customer engagements before picking up your own leads sourced from website enquiries, trade shows, and an element of proactive networking. You'll also make use of our CRM to revisit and work cold leads, including enquiries that have gone quiet for six months or more, alongside nurturing relationships across our large existing customer base.

We're currently at proof-of-concept stage with a number of clients, typically selling in batches of units, though some clients order units at a time. On the software side, deals typically range from around £20,000 £30,000 up to £200,000. On the hardware side, minimum order is units, but some clients order units deals of £100,000 or more.

You'll also work closely with our engineering team to tease out and translate customer requirements, acting as the interface between the customer and engineering throughout the sales process.

Successful candidates will have a good market knowledge of the automotive industry, an appreciation of the formation of partnerships, channel sales and OEM deal-making. You must possess demonstrable business skills, show adaptability, flexibility and a desire to work on a broad range of business initiatives. You must have a strong can-do attitude with the desire to deliver world-class solutions to blue-chip companies, and be motivated by seeing results deployed widely in real-life applications.

The role involves global travel, including Europe, Asia and the USA. There will be a mix of visiting our extensive customer base and new prospects, presenting at conferences and representing at trade shows.

Compensation

4% commission on all sales up to your initial annual target of £500,000

Once target is hit, this increases by a further 2% (6% total) on sales beyond that point

Any individual deal over £100,000 earns 6 8% commission

Our best and average performers are currently earning £30,000 £50,000 in commission on top of base salary taking total earnings to around £120,000 a year.

Vacancy No 5510

Job Title REGIONAL SALES ENGINEER

Location: NORTH WEST UK

PLEASE NOTE:The ideal candidate will be based within the wider Greater Manchester region, with particular consideration given to those located around South Manchester, Cheshire and nearby surrounding areas. This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of 2 to 3 days per week in the Central Manchester office initially during the onboarding and development period, reducing to 1 day per week once the individual is fully established in the role.

Job Description

Are you a commercially strong and technically credible HVAC sales professional with a proven ability to generate new business, influence specification and convert complex opportunities into profitable turnover?

We are partnered with a highly respected and award-winning UK HVAC solutions business with an outstanding reputation for delivering high-end, technically led heating, cooling and ventilation solutions across the built environment.

My client is recognised for its consultative and engineering-led approach to market, offering a broad and high-quality portfolio including chillers, air handling units, heat pumps, comfort cooling and other energy efficient HVAC solutions, supported by strong internal technical, estimating, design and engineering capability.

This is an excellent opportunity to join an ambitious and well-established business in a key regional sales role across the North West, taking ownership of a strategically important territory with genuine scope to develop both new and existing relationships across consultants, contractors, FM providers, end users and wider building services stakeholders.

This is not a passive account management role. It is a commercially focused, technically led sales position requiring someone who can create demand, build market presence, influence projects early, manage the sales process with confidence and convert opportunities into profitable business.

For the right person, this role offers autonomy, visibility, strong internal support and long-term career potential within a highly credible HVAC business.

The Company

My client is a successful and well-regarded UK HVAC turnkey solutions provider, offering both high-quality products and associated service support with a strong track record, premium technical offering and an enviable market reputation built through professionalism, delivery and engineering expertise.

The business supports clients with both off-the-shelf and bespoke applied HVAC solutions and has built lasting relationships across the commercial, industrial and specialist built environment sectors. Their commitment to product quality, project support and customer service has positioned them as a trusted partner within the HVAC and building services market.

My client also places real emphasis on the development of its people, offering a strong platform for progression, responsibility and long-term success.

The Opportunity

Due to continued growth, market expansion and ongoing project success, my client is looking to appoint a high calibre Regional Sales Engineer to drive commercial activity across the North West.

Operating in a hybrid capacity across the Central Manchester office, the field and from home as appropriate, you will take responsibility for promoting my client s HVAC product and service offering in a complete turnkey solutions sales capacity. You will be expected to identify opportunities, open doors, develop relationships, influence specifications, support solution development and manage opportunities from initial enquiry through to final negotiation and order placement.

You will be backed by an experienced internal team across estimating, design and engineering, but this role requires someone who is comfortable taking ownership of their territory, leading conversations in the market and creating momentum commercially.

The Role

This is a field-based regional sales role focused on business development, technical solution sales and commercial growth across the North West UK.

You will be responsible for promoting my client s full portfolio of applied and bespoke HVAC solutions, along with associated service offerings, across consultant/specifier, contractor, FM, end user and wider building services routes to market.

The position will involve a mix of developing new customers and maintaining existing relationships, although the initial emphasis is expected to be weighted more heavily towards new business generation and market development.

You will be expected to operate in a proactive, consultative and commercially disciplined manner, managing the full sales process from market engagement and lead generation through to quotation, negotiation and order conversion.

Responsibilities
  • Proactively promote my client s off-the-shelf and bespoke HVAC product offering, alongside associated service solutions, across the North West UK
  • Drive business development activity across consultants, specifiers, contractors, FM providers, commercial end users, industrial end users and other relevant stakeholders within the HVAC and building services market
  • Generate and develop sales leads, converting opportunities through a structured and commercially focused sales process
  • Manage opportunities from initial enquiry through to quotation, negotiation and order placement
  • Maintain and grow existing customer relationships while identifying and securing new business opportunities across the region
  • Work closely with internal estimating, design and engineering teams to develop and support technically appropriate solutions
  • Deliver technical and commercial presentations, seminars and customer meetings to strengthen market presence and opportunity creation
  • Evaluate market potential, understand customer requirements and identify areas for strategic growth
  • Provide technical advice and commercial input throughout the sales cycle
  • Produce monthly sales reports, manage pipeline activity and maintain a clear view of territory performance
  • Help formulate and execute targeted sales strategies to maximise revenue, margin and regional market penetration

Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required

Essential experience and attributes include:

Proven experience within the commercial HVAC sector

Strong track record in solution sales, applications sales or technically led HVAC sales

Good technical understanding of applied HVAC systems, particularly chillers, ideally including exposure to Turbocor, alongside related cooling, heating, air movement and heat pump solutions

Demonstrable success in promoting engineered HVAC solutions through consultant/specifier, contractor and end user routes to market

Experience generating and converting opportunities in excess of £1m turnover, with strong attention to margin and commercial quality

Existing or transferable relationships with consultants, HVAC specifiers, HVAC contractors, FM providers and commercial, industrial or specialist end users across the region

Ability to engage with a broad range of stakeholders, both externally and internally, and work collaboratively to develop engineered solutions

Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills

High level of self-motivation and ability to operate autonomously with minimal supervision

Commercial discipline, professionalism and a strategic approach to territory development

Comfortable using Microsoft Office and standard business systems for reporting, presentations and communication

Engineering qualification to HND or degree level would be advantageous, but is not essential

Leadership or managerial capability would be advantageous, though not essential

The Person

This role will suit someone who enjoys autonomy, responsibility and the challenge of building commercial success through technical credibility and market presence.

You may already be operating in a Regional Sales Engineer, internal sales, technical sales support or applications-based commercial role within HVAC or be in a similar technically led sales environment and ready to step into a broader territory position with greater ownership and visibility.

You will be comfortable engaging with consultants, contractors, FM businesses, end users and wider building services stakeholders, and you will know how to navigate specification, technical discussion and commercial negotiation with confidence.

You are not someone who waits for opportunities to arrive. You are proactive, organised and commercially sharp, with the drive to open doors, create traction and move projects forward.

You take pride in representing technically strong solutions and want to be part of a business where engineering support, quality of delivery and market credibility genuinely back up the sales proposition.

You will combine relationship building ability with commercial edge, and you will be motivated not only by revenue generation but by developing a strong reputation in the market and becoming a trusted regional figure for the business.

What s in it for you?
  • Strong basic salary up to £50,000 with flexibility for an exceptional individual
  • 12% uncapped commission on GP above £200,000
  • £440 per month car allowance
  • Pension & Healthcare
  • Mobile and laptop
  • 25 days holiday
  • Genuine long-term career development and progression opportunities

description:
Recruitment Sales Executive (Part-Time)

Fully Remote

£17.50 per hour + 10% commission on new business

10 hours per week initially, with potential to increase to around 15 hours

Freelance 12-month contract Initial 4-week paid performance review

E Junior Recruitment is looking for a commercially minded Recruitment Sales Executive to help grow a new managed recruitment service for UK employers.

This is not a traditional sales role where you will be handed a CRM full of warm leads, an existing client list or paid prospecting software. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline from scratch, deciding which businesses to target, finding the right decision-makers and developing an outbound strategy that you believe can generate new clients.

We are deliberately looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for daily instructions.

The Service

E Junior Recruitment provides a managed recruitment campaign service for businesses that need help attracting and screening suitable candidates.

Rather than simply supplying CVs, the service is designed to support employers with the recruitment campaign itself, helping them reach suitable applicants and reduce the time involved in managing the early stages of hiring.

Your role is to identify businesses that are likely to benefit from this service and turn them into paying clients.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Researching and identifying suitable UK businesses to target
  • Building your own prospect list using free, publicly available or personally accessible resources
  • Identifying relevant decision-makers
  • Creating and testing your own outbound sales approach
  • Prospecting through appropriate channels such as telephone, email, LinkedIn and professional networking
  • Starting conversations with prospective clients and identifying genuine recruitment needs
  • Explaining the managed recruitment service clearly and commercially
  • Following up opportunities consistently
  • Managing prospects from first contact through to proposal and sale
  • Recording your own activity, pipeline and results
  • Reviewing what is and is not working and adapting your strategy accordingly

IMPORTANT: What is NOT Provided:

There is currently no existing CRM, prospect database, purchased lead list or paid sales intelligence platform provided with this role.

You must therefore be comfortable sourcing your own prospects and building a client base from the beginning using your own knowledge, research methods and free/public resources.

You will of course be given full information about the service you are selling, but you will not be given a step-by-step prospecting strategy. A major part of the role is demonstrating that you can develop and execute one yourself.

Who we are looking for:

We are open to candidates from recruitment sales, business development, new business, account management, partnerships or other B2B sales backgrounds.

Recruitment-sector experience is useful but is not essential. More important is evidence that you can independently create opportunities rather than relying entirely on inbound leads or an established database.

You are likely to suit this role if you:

  • Enjoy building something from scratch
  • Are confident approaching completely cold B2B prospects
  • Can research markets and identify commercial opportunities independently
  • Are organised enough to manage your own pipeline
  • Follow up consistently
  • Can explain a service clearly and confidently
  • Are comfortable being accountable for measurable commercial results
  • Test, learn and change your approach when something is not working
  • Want the freedom to use your own ideas rather than follow a rigid sales script

Hours and Flexibility

The role starts at 10 hours per week and is fully remote.

Hours can be worked flexibly, although some availability during normal UK business hours will be required for prospect calls and meetings.

This makes the opportunity suitable for someone looking for a serious part-time sales role alongside other work or freelance commitments, provided you can give the role the time and consistency it requires.

The Initial 4-Week Review

The first four weeks are fully paid at £17.50 per hour and will be used as an initial performance and commercial viability review.

We will look at the quality and consistency of your activity, the opportunities you create, qualified conversations, meetings, proposals and ultimately new client sales.

This is intended to be an ongoing 12-month freelance opportunity rather than a four-week temporary job. Where the role is producing strong commercial results, hours may increase to around 15 per week after the initial review and there may be scope to continue beyond the initial contract.

Pay

  • £17.50 per hour
  • 10 hours per week initially
  • Potential increase to approximately 15 hours per week
  • 10% commission on new business generated
  • Fully remote and flexible working

Application Process

We are looking for people who genuinely want ownership of new business development.

If you are someone who can take a service, identify the right market for it and build a client base without needing a ready-made list of prospects, we would be very interested to hear from you.

title: Sales Advisor - Part Time
description:
Where: EE Gosforth (Gosforth Park Way, Newcastle upon Tyne NE12 8ET) or EE Tyneside (Silver Fox Way, Newcastle upon Tyne NE27 0QJ)

Part time: Permanent

Hours: 20 hours per week (evenings)

Start date: October 2026 onwards

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths

  • Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
  • It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
  • People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months 9 (pro rata)

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

You'll receive an attractive compensation package including base salary, commission, and a starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and continue building momentum.

Global community & diversity

Implement. Improve. Challenge. Make ERP Actually Work for the Customer.

Great ERP consultants don't just implement software - they transform how businesses work.

This is a role for an experienced ERP consultant who wants more than project delivery. You'll stay close to the customer, own the outcome and help businesses get genuine, lasting value from their ERP system.

You'll combine commercial insight, technical expertise and hands-on problem-solving across the entire customer journey - from discovery and implementation to go-live, optimisation and ongoing success.

The Role at a Glance

Senior ERP Consultant
